Frequently Asked Questions 








What is Agentic AI SOC?
+ 




Agentic AI SOC is an autonomous, AI-powered Security Operations Center that continuously monitors, detects, and responds to cyber threats in real time. It combines AI-driven threat detection, automated response, and human expertise to reduce risk and strengthen your cybersecurity posture. 







What is Managed Detection and Response (MDR)?
+ 




Managed Detection and Response (MDR) combines AI-driven technology and human expertise to detect, investigate, and respond to cyber threats 24/7. It strengthens your organization’s defenses by identifying and containing attacks in real time. 







How does AI improve Managed Detection and Response?
+ 




AI enhances MDR by analyzing vast security data, detecting anomalies faster, and prioritizing critical alerts. This reduces false positives, shortens response times, and enables proactive threat mitigation. 







What is SOC-as-a-Service and how does it work?
+ 




SOC-as-a-Service delivers 24/7 monitoring and incident response from a cloud-based Security Operations Center managed by cybersecurity experts. Proficio’s Agentic AI SOC ensures enterprise-grade protection without the cost of building an in-house SOC. 







What are the benefits of using Proficio’s MDR services?
+ 




Proficio’s MDR services provide continuous threat monitoring, AI-powered detection, rapid incident response, and actionable threat intelligence. Our solution bridges resource gaps and enhances compliance while reducing cyber risk exposure. 







What is AI-powered threat detection?
+ 




AI-powered threat detection uses machine learning and behavioral analytics to identify abnormal patterns and malicious activities across networks, cloud environments, and endpoints—helping detect attacks before they cause harm. 







How is Proficio’s MDR different from traditional security monitoring?
+ 




Unlike traditional monitoring, Proficio’s MDR combines advanced AI automation, human expertise, and proactive response actions. Our platform doesn’t just alert you—it responds in real time to neutralize threats automatically. 







What is LLM cybersecurity?
+ 




LLM cybersecurity leverages large language models (LLMs) to correlate, contextualize, and analyze threat intelligence. It enables faster insights, smarter automation, and more accurate decision-making within SOC environments, including Agentic AI SOCs. 







Why is SOC automation important for modern cybersecurity?
+ 




SOC automation reduces manual investigation time by automating alert triage, log correlation, and response actions. It enhances efficiency, consistency, and speed, allowing analysts to focus on high-priority threats. 







How do LLMs support Agentic AI SOC operations?
+ 




Large language models (LLMs) enhance Agentic AI SOC operations by analyzing massive datasets, identifying patterns, and providing actionable insights. They improve threat detection, automation, and decision-making for SOC teams. 







Which industries benefit most from Agentic AI SOC and MDR services?
+ 




Industries such as finance, healthcare, manufacturing, and government benefit most from Agentic AI SOC and MDR services due to their need for compliance, continuous monitoring, and rapid incident response against evolving cyber threats. 







How can businesses get started with Proficio Agentic AI SOC services?
+ 




Getting started is simple. Request a demo or consultation with Proficio’s cybersecurity team. We assess your environment, identify security gaps, and design a customized Agentic AI SOC or MDR solution powered by AI and expert analysts.
